raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: jxlpy
  version: "0.9.5"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/jxlpy-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2aa766f1bde180ed10df313af2b48833825deeea631be490cb04ac786c021542
  patches:
    - remove-cython-runtime.patch
    - if: win
      then: support-windows.patch

build:
  number: 9
  script:
    - python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
        - pip
        - python
        - setuptools
  host:
    - cython
    - libjxl
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools
  run:
    - libjxl
    - pillow
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - jxlpy
  - script:
      - pip check
      - python run_test.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python
    files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/olokelo/jxlpy
  repository: https://github.com/olokelo/jxlpy
  summary: Cython bindings and Pillow plugin for JPEG XL
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
